items.name: Finsupp.sum_add
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : Zero M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N] {f : α →₀ M}
  {h₁ h₂ : α → M → N}, (f.sum fun a b => h₁ a b + h₂ a b) = f.sum h₁ + f.sum h₂

items.name: Finsupp.sum_toMultiset
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid α] (f : α →₀ ℕ), (Finsupp.toMultiset f).sum = f.sum fun a n => n • a

items.name: Finsupp.instAdd
items.type: {ι : Type u_1} → {M : Type u_3} → [inst : AddZeroClass M] → Add (ι →₀ M)

items.name: Finsupp.sum_add_index
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_8} {N : Type u_10} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : AddZeroClass M]
  [inst_2 : AddCommMonoid N] {f g : α →₀ M} {h : α → M → N},
  (∀ a ∈ f.support ∪ g.support, h a 0 = 0) →
    (∀ a ∈ f.support ∪ g.support, ∀ (b₁ b₂ : M), h a (b₁ + b₂) = h a b₁ + h a b₂) → (f + g).sum h = f.sum h + g.sum h

items.name: DFinsupp.mk_add
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u} {β : ι → Type v} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → AddZeroClass (β i)] {s : Finset ι}
  {x y : (i : ↑↑s) → β ↑i}, DFinsupp.mk s (x + y) = DFinsupp.mk s x + DFinsupp.mk s y
